historical_status: Repeatedly inspected history; exploratory comparison only
future_rules: No tuning or model selection using future results. Freeze model checkpoints before 2027-01-01; seal monthly predictions before that month's first trading session. No interim performance-driven changes. Evaluate only after all 12 exits are observed. Late or unsealed predictions invalidate prospective claims. Future data/forecasts are not generated by this historical runner.
ensemble: Equal arithmetic mean of three seed predictions; same keys required
primary_comparison: FT ensemble minus residual MLP ensemble, monthly executed net long-only top-decile standard Sharpe; all 12 future months required
uncertainty: Paired contiguous month block bootstrap, lengths 3 and 6, 2000 draws, fixed random seed 814. Report intervals and all seeds; do not treat 12 months as strong significance evidence.
success_rule: No claim of reliable superiority from positive point estimate alone. Require positive paired net monthly mean-return delta and Sharpe delta with both block-length 95% lower bounds above zero, FT positive Sharpe, no worse maximum drawdown, and positive Sharpe delta in at least 2 of 3 matched seeds. Otherwise report inconclusive or tradeoffs. No alternate winning criterion after inspection.
costs: Frozen existing backtest template commissions/taxes, plus 5 and 10 bps extra per side; do not optimize costs
timing: Existing verified V3 source-month relabel and price-built target; first session close to next month's first session close is an execution assumption. Vendor-specific publication timing remains a limitation.
universe: Frozen project config and point-in-time eligibility. No ex-post exclusion list in primary evaluation. Missing held prices block primary results; existing retrospective exclusions may only be separately labeled sensitivity analysis.
training_adaptation: Same original project rolling training/validation/purge, MSE, epoch budgets, early stopping, scheduler, warm starts, gradient clipping and period batching for both models, frozen in identity.json. These are A-share adaptations, NOT reproduction of the paper's full benchmark/training procedure. FT starts each window optimizer at paper default lr=0.0001 and decay=0.00001, with official excluded parameter groups; baseline retains original optimizer. Thus compare fixed model recipes, not attention alone.
architecture: Official Tokenizer, MultiheadAttention and Transformer class bodies unchanged; 3 blocks, token192, 8 heads, ReGLU, FFN factor4/3, dropout attention0.2/FFN0.1/residual0, PreNorm with first attention norm omitted, CLS readout, no KV compression
data_rule: Real observed data only. Audit raw features, rank finite large values without clipping in float64, then cast bounded percentile ranks to float32. Missing realized returns never zero-filled. Rank transform exact registered config required.
protocol_changes: New experiment ID and new registration required. Cannot reuse future interval already inspected to validate a changed recipe. Local hashes are tamper-evident consistency checks, not independent third-party preregistration.
numeric_revision: 2026-10-25: finite raw values ranked BEFORE float32 narrowing, preserving average ties and missing values. Infinities block. Both models retrain identically in new experiment. Earlier float32 rounding ties may also change; no old checkpoints reused.
